body:
People - NOVEMBER 19, 2026

South Korea’s National Pension Service (NPS) has named Han Seong-hee, currently head of its investment strategy division, to serve as head of real estate investment overseeing the organization’s KRW 70 trillion ($53 billion) real estate portfolio following the dismissal of controversy-plagued former real estate head Ahn Jun-sang in early November after he was relieved of his duties in mid-July, reports The Korea Economic Daily. According to Seoul Property Insight, the leadership shakeup is expected to change NPS’ real estate investment strategy, which had focused on expanding domestic property investment under Ahn.

p: The Korea Economic Daily에 따르면, 국민연금은 지난 7월 중순 직무가 정지된 후 논란 끝에 11어 초 해임된 안준상 전 부동산실장의 후임으로, 70조 원(530억 달러) 규모의 부동산 포트폴리오를 총괄할 새로운 부동산실장에 한성희 현 투자전략실장을 임명했다고 밝혔다. Seoul Property Insight에 따르면, 이번 리더십 교체로 안준상 전 실장 체제 하에서 국내 부동산 투자 확대에 집중해왔던 국민연금의 부동산 투자 전략에 변화가 생길 것으로 예상된다.
